title: PlacementLedger
description: The committed skill-placement ledger (UI-SPEC §5.3, ARCHITECTURE §10.4). Written by `lst compile`, never hand-edited: `lst baseline` check 9 fails CI if an existing assignment changes.

cellDivisor.description: One global divisor for every region (UI-SPEC Q2). Frozen at the first committed assignment — changing it renumbers the spiral and reflows every region, the exact N11 failure this ledger exists to prevent. There is deliberately no per-region override.

cell.description: Sub-lattice axial coordinates. Integers: the sub-lattice is the parent lattice scaled by 1/cellDivisor about the same origin, so no cell is ever fractional.
